title: Data-driven Circuit Discovery for Interpretability of Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.09129v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Circuit study aims to explain how language models (LMs) implement a task by localizing and interpreting a circuit: a computational subgraph responsible for a specific model's behavior. Existing methods for circuit localization are largely hypothesis-driven: they define a task through a dataset, assume that all examples in the task are implemented by the same mechanism, and apply circuit discovery to obtain a single circuit. This workflow does not account for mechanistic diversity within a task, where different examples may rely on different mechanisms. We first show that when a dataset mixes tasks processed through distinct mechanisms, current circuit discovery can combine these mechanisms into a single circuit while retaining faithfulness comparable to circuits discovered on each task separately. translated_title: 数据驱动的语言模型可解释性电路发现方法
translated_abstract: 电路研究旨在通过定位和解释电路来解释语言模型（LMs）如何实现一个任务：电路是负责特定模型行为的计算子图。现有的电路定位方法主要是假设驱动的：它们通过数据集定义一个任务，假设任务中的所有示例都由相同的机制实现，然后应用电路发现方法来获得单一电路。这种工作流程没有考虑到任务内部的机制多样性，即不同的示例可能依赖于不同的机制。我们首先证明，当一个数据集混合了通过不同机制处理的任务时，当前的电路发现方法可以将这些机制合并为单一电路，同时保持与分别在每个任务上发现的电路相当的忠实性。在四个任务和三个模型上，我们进一步提供了单个任务内部存在这种机制多样性的证据。为应对这一问题……
tldr: 该论文揭示了单个任务内部存在机制多样性（不同示例可能依赖不同的计算机制），并提出数据驱动的电路发现方法，能够将混合机制自动分解为多个独立电路，从而更准确地解释语言模型的内部行为。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals mechanistic diversity within individual tasks and proposes a data-driven circuit discovery approach that automatically decomposes mixed mechanisms into multiple distinct circuits, enabling more faithful interpretation of language model behavior.
